exposure: abnormal amniotic fluid volume (oligohydramnios or polyhydramnios)
outcome: fetal distress (abnormal fetal heart rate or meconium-stained liquor)
low birth weight (less than 10th percentile for gestation age)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant patients, 50 with normal amniotic fluid volume and 50 with either oligohydramnios or polyhydramnios.
finding: Abnormal amniotic fluid volume (oligohydramnios or polyhydramnios) was significantly associated with higher rates of induction of labor, cesarean section, meconium-stained liquor, low birth weight, increased NICU admission, and lower Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Abnormal amniotic fluid volume was associated with higher rates of induction of labor and cesarean section.
